title: Iteration over None in breakpoint calculation
detail: If either horizontal_breakpoints or vertical_breakpoints is None, the comprehension will raise a TypeError because None is not iterable. The surrounding if condition only checks that at least one list is truthy, but does not guard against the other being None.

title: Uncaught ImportError when importing vendored modules
detail: The function now always returns a ModuleType and never returns None. If the vendored module does not exist or cannot be imported, importlib.import_module will raise ImportError, propagating up to callers such as get_vendor_version_from_module and causing the type‑check command to crash. The original implementation returned None on failure, allowing callers to handle missing modules gracefully.
